evals.prompt: I have a CSV of city eviction filings. Can you set up a repo for it?
evals.expected_output: Short scoping (section 1), then a plan showing the five working files and which sections are now/later/skip, approved before writing. Scaffolds only the five working files plus the data dictionary and data/ layout; no pipeline, governance or OKF bundle.
expectations: Asks about or records sensitivity and visibility before scaffolding (eviction filings name people)
Waits for approval before writing files
Creates README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md, decision-log.md, CHANGELOG.md
Does not create GOVERNANCE.md, CHARTER.md, checklists, an OKF bundle or a deposit kit unless the user marked those sections now
Does not mention levels L0-L5

evals.prompt: Set up a reproducible Python project for analyzing eviction data, with a pipeline that re-runs when the data is refreshed.
evals.expected_output: Scopes, then scaffolds the pipeline with data-liberation's project template (uv, pyproject.toml, scripts/, python -m scripts.pipeline run) and a refresh workflow, not a conda/Snakemake stack; Snakemake only if asked, as a wrapper.
expectations: Uses pyproject.toml with uv and code under scripts/
Does not require Snakemake or environment.yml
Includes a recurring refresh that opens a reviewable PR

evals.prompt: We're starting a multi-partner project with sensitive tenant records across three housing nonprofits. Help me set up the repository.
evals.expected_output: Marks sensitivity = sensitive-human, so section 7 safeguards are now regardless of other deferrals: GOVERNANCE with access tiers, retention, remedy; CHARTER with roles; the responsible-data checklist filled from the scoping conversation; docs under docs/governance/ and docs/checklists/; one issue per now section because there is a team.
expectations: Treats governance safeguards as required now because the data is sensitive
Fills the responsible-data checklist from the scoping answers rather than leaving it blank
Any approval-by-PR rule is paired with a branch-protection step
Plans one issue per now section

evals.prompt: Audit this repository against open, reproducible, and inclusive data standards and tell me what's missing.
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit: verifies the checkout is level with origin, scores the repo against each Outline section's done-when test, prints a prioritized gap table by section, and offers remediation without modifying the repo.
expectations: Does not modify the repository
Reports gaps organized by Outline section, not by level
Checks the checkout against the remote default branch first

evals.prompt: We're publishing this eviction dataset so other agents can find and use it. Set up agent discovery.
evals.expected_output: Section 9 discovery: generates ai-catalog.json and DISCOVERY.md with domain-anchored URNs and the spec version the template uses; records hosting at .well-known and registry registration as ROADMAP items.
expectations: Generates ai-catalog.json and DISCOVERY.md
Defers hosting and registry registration to ROADMAP rows rather than claiming they are done

evals.prompt: We've finished the analysis. Deposit the processed data, code, and documentation to Harvard Dataverse so we get a DOI.
evals.expected_output: Section 9 deposit via procedures/deposit.md: gates on sensitivity first; maps data/processed to Data, scripts/ and pipeline files to Code, README and docs/data-dictionary.md to Documentation; defaults to the demo sandbox; stops at a draft and publishes only on explicit confirmation.
expectations: Checks sensitivity before depositing
Defaults to the demo sandbox or a dry run
Does not publish (mint the DOI) without explicit confirmation
Never asks to commit the API token

evals.prompt: We deposit this dataset to Harvard Dataverse and refresh it every quarter. Set that up.
evals.expected_output: Emits the deposit kit plus a scheduled re-deposit workflow that creates a draft new version and opens a review issue; first refresh is a major version, later refreshes minor.
expectations: The scheduled workflow creates a draft version and does not publish on its own
States the versioning rule: first refresh major, later refreshes minor

evals.prompt: We want to share our processed datasets with a partner organization without giving them a copy of the data. Wire up OpenSharing.
evals.expected_output: Emits the opensharing/ declaration kit gated by GOVERNANCE access tiers; does not run a server or vend credentials.
expectations: Emits share.json and SHARING.md
States that it does not run a sharing server or issue credentials
Ties what enters the share to the governance access tiers

evals.prompt: We're liberating four different data sources into one repo, each with its own pipeline. Set up CI that tests all of them, and make sure adding a fifth later doesn't mean editing the workflow.
evals.expected_output: Multi-pipeline repo: pipelines/<name>/ each a data-liberation-shaped project, shared plumbing in pipelines/_core/, CI discovers pipelines/*/pyproject.toml and runs each pipeline's tests.
expectations: CI discovers pipelines by pyproject.toml, not by Snakefile
Each pipeline has its own pyproject.toml and tests
Shared plumbing goes in a shared core rather than being copied between pipelines

evals.prompt: It's just me on this project, but set up governance properly.
evals.expected_output: Writes an honest single-steward governance statement and correction path; no committee, no approval-by-PR rule without branch protection.
expectations: Describes a single steward rather than inventing roles or reviewers
Does not claim PR-approval gates that nothing enforces

evals.prompt: We just finished a two-week sprint and the skill's advice on reconciling OCR'd totals was useless. What should I do with that?
evals.expected_output: Helps run a short after-action review and prepares a sprint-feedback issue for CUPIDS-Lab/data-skills against section 3, with the sensitive-details check; files it only on confirmation.
expectations: Points to the sprint-feedback form on CUPIDS-Lab/data-skills
Maps the gap to an Outline section (3 Extract)
Asks the user to remove sensitive details and confirms before filing
